Laura / Marissa — triage summary so far (logs attached):

Findings:
- One node (node-az1-03, GPU-A100-sku) is showing sustained user-space stalls and elevated runqueue length starting ~07:42 PT. dmesg shows repeated softlockup warnings tied to specific kernel driver invoking cuda-ipc.
- The Redwood runtime's shard placement assigned a high proportion of long-sequence requests to that node after a recent shard-balance rebalance (automated).
- KV cache hit rates are high overall, but we see a disproportionate number of long-context requests (~>2048 tokens) routed to the hot node.
- Error pattern: timeouts at the shard proxy layer leading to 502 aggregated to the API gateway.

Immediate mitigations applied (09:00 PT):
- Took node-az1-03 out of the rotation and rebalanced live traffic to az1-01/02.
- Temporarily lowered per-shard concurrency to 6 and enforced per-route max-token-length of 2048.
- Deployed a kernel workaround (module param change) to reduce preemption pressure — monitoring for regressions.

Remaining risks / asks:
- If the kernel fix is insufficient, we may need a rolling node reboot which requires coordination and possible short tail spikes.
- We need an emergency priority JIRA for a targeted serving runtime hotfix to change shard balancing logic for long-sequence affinity.
- Requesting exec sign-off to schedule a 2-hour out-of-hours maintenance window if rolling reboots are required.

I've attached a concise timeline and logs (see Drive link in thread). Will update in 30 minutes with further metrics.

Irene Choi
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
